results.question: My printer is not printing anything
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: TKT-031, the issue of the printer not printing could be due to the print spooler hanging, which can cause print jobs to sit in the queue with an 'Error' status. The resolution involved clearing the stuck jobs and restarting the Print Spooler service, which allowed a test page to print successfully. 

If you are experiencing a similar issue, you may want to check the print spooler status.

results.question: I cannot access SAP after my account was locked
results.answer:
To unlock your SAP account, it was confirmed that accounts can be auto-locked by the dormancy policy after 90 days of inactivity. In a similar case (Ticket ID: TKT-048), the account was reactivated in SU01, and the user was required to log in and change their password to confirm access was restored. 

If your account is locked, you may need to have it reactivated and then change your password.

results.question: My laptop screen went black and won't turn on
results.answer: Based on Ticket ID: TKT-019, the resolution for a laptop that will not power on is to isolate the fault. In that case, it was determined that the issue was with a failed dock power adapter rather than the laptop itself. The recommended steps are to connect the laptop directly to a known-good charger, perform a battery-drain reset, and if necessary, replace any faulty power adapters. After these steps, the laptop should boot normally.

results.question: I need access to Power BI for my team
results.answer:
To grant Power BI access to your team, you can follow a similar process as outlined in Ticket ID: TKT-014. In that case, the analyst was assigned a Power BI Pro license in the Microsoft 365 admin center and added to the Finance workspace as a Viewer. Ensure that your team members have the appropriate licenses and are added to the relevant workspaces. 

If you need further assistance, please refer to Ticket ID: TKT-078, where a user regained access after a manual sync was performed due to a failed sync job. 

For more detailed steps, you may need to consult your IT department or the Microsoft documentation.

results.question: Network drive is not showing up on my computer
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: GH-MIC-239224, the issue regarding accessing a network share may relate to your problem with the network drive not appearing. The resolution indicated that the problem was related to UNC network shares. It suggests ensuring that the correct URL format is used when trying to access the network share. 

If you are having trouble with a network drive, make sure you are using the correct path and that the share is properly configured. 

If you need further assistance, please provide more details about the issue.

results.question: I forgot my Windows password and am locked out
results.answer:
To reset a forgotten Windows password, you can verify your identity through a manager or employee ID, then reset the Active Directory password and clear any account lockout. After that, you can set a new password at the next logon. This process is similar to what was done in Ticket ID: TKT-007, where the user's identity was verified, and the password was reset. 

Ticket ID: TKT-007.

results.question: VPN disconnects every few minutes while working from home
results.answer: To fix frequent VPN disconnects while working from home, you can refer to Ticket ID: TKT-004. The resolution involved tracing the drops to an aggressive idle-timeout on the user's consumer router and a low DPD value in the group policy. The solution was to raise the dead-peer-detection interval on the VPN profile and disable the router's Wi-Fi power-saving mode, which stabilized the session.

results.question: Printer shows offline but is turned on
results.answer: The printer is showing offline because it had picked up a new DHCP address while its print queue still pointed at the old IP. A DHCP reservation was set for the printer's MAC, the port on the print server was updated to the new address, and it was confirmed that the queue came back online for all users. This information is based on Ticket ID: TKT-036.

results.question: Computer is running very slowly after Windows update
results.answer:
To fix slow computer performance after a Windows update, you can refer to Ticket ID: TKT-095. The resolution involved rolling back a broken generic Bluetooth driver that was causing issues across the office fleet. This suggests that after a Windows update, checking for driver issues and rolling back to a previous known-good version may help improve performance. 

Resolution: Confirmed the update had shipped a broken generic Bluetooth driver. Rolled back the driver to the previous known-good version fleet-wide via SCCM and blocked the problematic driver update from redeploying until the vendor issued a fix. 

Ticket ID: TKT-095

results.question: Cannot install Adobe Acrobat on my work laptop
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: TKT-151, the issue of being unable to install an application on a work laptop is addressed. The resolution involved confirming that the laptop was under a standard-user policy that blocks local-admin installs. Instead of granting standing admin rights, the approved application package was pushed through the Company Portal / Software Center, allowing it to install under the system account. 

If you are facing a similar issue with Adobe Acrobat, you may need to follow a similar process.

results.question: WiFi keeps dropping in the conference room
results.answer:
The issue of WiFi dropping in the conference room may be related to network configuration or coverage. Based on Ticket ID: TKT-130, a Wi-Fi site survey was conducted to confirm adequate coverage in a new conference room build-out, and the network was tested before handing it over. If there are ongoing issues, it may be beneficial to conduct a similar survey or check the configuration. 

Resolution from Ticket ID: TKT-130: "Coordinated with facilities to terminate the new network drops, configured switch ports for the room's AV controller and camera, ran a Wi-Fi site survey to confirm adequate coverage, and tested a full Teams meeting from the room before handing it over."

results.question: Account locked after too many wrong password attempts
results.answer: To unlock your account after too many failed password attempts, you can follow the resolution from Ticket ID: TKT-067. In that case, the executive's smart card PIN was locked after too many failed attempts. The resolution involved verifying the identity in person and then reissuing a working smart card. If you are unable to do this in person, you may need to contact your IT support team for assistance in verifying your identity and unlocking your account.

results.question: AnyConnect shows login failed after password reset
results.answer:
Based on Ticket ID: TKT-001, the resolution for a similar issue states that the user's Active Directory account was locked due to repeated failed MFA prompts. The account was unlocked in AD, the Duo MFA device pairing was reset, and it was confirmed that AnyConnect connected successfully to the GR-VPN gateway. 

If you are experiencing a login failure after a password reset, it may be worth checking if your account is locked or if there are issues with MFA.
